## Bottom line

A 2020-era page that was never updated (footer: Copyright 2020). The vote claims refer to 2019 measures passed while he was in office, but they carry no bill numbers or vote records.

1. He has served since an April 2018 special election, so he was in office for the 2019 congestion-pricing and bail votes.
